context: Tests whether the agent correctly identifies architecture violations (engine doing IO/printing/exits, compliance inside engine, business logic in CLI) and produces a refactored example following the correct separation: thin CLI, pure engine, compliance as sidecar running after providers and before reporters, with correct exit codes.

checklist.name: Engine IO violation identified
checklist.description: architecture_review.md identifies that the engine must not do IO, printing, or exit calls — and flags the print/sys.exit calls inside the engine in the draft

checklist.name: CLI thinness violation identified
checklist.description: architecture_review.md identifies that the CLI should only do argument parsing and wiring, not contain policy or compliance logic

checklist.name: Compliance sidecar placement identified
checklist.description: architecture_review.md explains that compliance must run as a sidecar AFTER providers and BEFORE reporters, not inline with providers

checklist.name: Engine is pure in refactored example
checklist.description: refactored_example.py shows PolicyEngine with no print(), sys.exit(), or file IO calls

checklist.name: Compliance runs after providers
checklist.description: refactored_example.py calls the compliance sidecar after all provider results are collected, not inside the provider loop

checklist.name: Compliance runs before reporters
checklist.description: refactored_example.py calls reporters after the compliance sidecar (not before)

checklist.name: Compliance profiles mentioned
checklist.description: architecture_review.md names at least two of the three compliance profiles: default, eu, eu-strict

checklist.name: Compliance activation flags
checklist.description: architecture_review.md mentions that compliance is enabled via policy.compliance.enabled or --compliance / --compliance-only flags

checklist.name: Correct exit code for blocking
checklist.description: refactored_example.py exits with code 1 when decision mode is 'blocking' and code 0 for allow or advisory

checklist.name: Compliance checks described
checklist.description: architecture_review.md mentions at least two of: forbidden licenses (GPL/AGPL), secret detection, GDPR data residency as what compliance sidecar checks

checklist.name: CLI only wires components
checklist.description: refactored_example.py shows CLI code that only calls/wires engine, providers, compliance, and reporters without containing business logic

checklist.name: No compliance inside engine
checklist.description: refactored_example.py does NOT call any compliance check from within the PolicyEngine class/function
